verdict.rationale: Proa documents that one typed component can render to HTML, Markdown, and "other render targets". The GitHub README shows a per-target `render_md(cx)` method with a `to_markdown` delegate, and the docs pair HTML and Markdown views through `md!` templates. So the component model clearly targets outputs beyond browser HTML. Nothing shows a developer authoring a brand-new renderer for an arbitrary platform. missing for 10: documented API or guide for writing custom renderers, examples of non-HTML/Markdown platform targets (e.g., native or terminal), independent corroboration.
